original_DoAs_backend: MuJoCo Warp, NVIDIA L40S, CUDA device 2 visibility; see original-fixture logs
scope: Comparisons only use finished scored rows. Wall caps measure whether the recorded completed output was available by its cap; wall rates depend on contemporaneous host load. No output after an artificial early truncation is imputed.
initial: Common registered initial state is cached and its separately measured creation time is reported and also charged once in the second wall column. Episodes share source preparation; per-case preparation outside the recorded wall clocks and cache-only cold/warm compilation split are unmeasured.
G4_cost: G4 runner wall includes generation and nominal independent replay. The adapted baseline precommits then calls the same runner; its generation and independent replay wall times are added. G4 advance uses the complete locked prefix or the independent native failure at the same terminal search window. Both use identical control/state and native failure predicates. A failed mj_step is charged once in independent attempts and once, if applicable, in advancement. independent_physics_steps contains only completed steps.
